name: Telfie Moongale
source: Tefli is one of the last surviving fae who called the Moonlight Glade home. Determined to seek justice for the travesty against her home, Tefli is an ally who can join [url=/c166785]Ryder[/url] on his journey. She's spunky, determined, and raunchy.
